description: Change a token picture any time (also after graduation to Uniswap). Only the token creator wallet can do it, by EIP-191 personal_sign. Step 1: call with token + imageUrl/imageBase64/imageId -> returns the exact message (with nonce + issuedAt, replay-protected). Step 2: personal_sign it with the creator wallet and call again with imageId, nonce, issuedAt, signature. Old versions are kept. This tool never touches keys.

imageBase64.description: raw base64 or data:image/...;base64,... of the picture (max 2 MB)

imageUrl.description: REQUIRED unless imageId/imageBase64 is given: https:// (or ipfs://) link to a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, min 64x64, max 2 MB. We fetch, validate and re-host it.

name: update_token_image
